messages:
zach.engineer: Noticed my carryover from last year (24h) is missing in the balance view this morning. I was sure I had approved carryover. Did the year-end job run?
hr-bot: Year-end carryover batch completed at 09:00 UTC. If you think your balance is wrong, please tag people-ops and include ticket. See policy: https://redwood.company/policies/pto#carryover
olivia-peopleops: Sorry Zach  we saw a handful of international profiles (EMEA/APAC) where carryover flags didn't persist after the HRIS migration. We're investigating. Can you DM me your employee ID so I can check the raw record?
zach.engineer: DM sent (ID 48752). I also have the Lattice note with manager approval if that helps.
anita_mgr: I approved Zach's carryover in Lattice on Dec 19 and added note "manager approves 24h carryover due to project travel". We didn't get any error msgs.
\oljk: (oops wrong user)
jess.payroll: Confirming we observed an edge-case in the migration: timezone normalization changed some date comparisons and the carryover flag was cleared for employees whose timezone caused the effective date to fall after the migration cutoff. We're preparing a restore script but need People Ops confirmation before changing HRIS records.
olivia-peopleops: Thanks Jess. Required steps: 1) verify manager approval exists in Lattice (Anita confirmed), 2) collect impacted employee IDs, 3) create a people-ops ticket and approve a bulk restore with expiry/notes. We'll also email affected folks.
ajkl: (ignore)
zach.engineer: Appreciated. Rough ETA? Flights are in Jan and I need the hours posted before Jan payroll.
jess.payroll: ETA for restore script is 24-48 hours. If we run before Jan 3 batch it will appear on balances. If not, we'll do a manual off-cycle fix Jan 5. We need explicit People Ops sign-off to modify historical records.
olivia-peopleops: Signing off here. Anita please confirm manager note is attached to the Lattice request and archive it as proof. Then I'll approve the restore ticket.
anita_mgr: Done  note attached and I added: "confirming carryover approval for Zach (24h)".
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-12021  olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-12021
\oljk: (sorry again, ignore)
\oljk: sorry
zach.engineer: Thanks everyone. Please cc me on the ticket so I can follow up.\oljk: (this channel is noisy today)
jess.payroll: CC'ed Zach on PO-12021. We'll run the restore tonight at 02:00 UTC and confirm when done.
olivia-peopleops: We'll also send a short note to all impacted employees explaining the issue, the fix, and expected posting date.
hr-bot: Restore completed: carryover flags restored for 12 employees including 48752. Balances should reflect changes within 2 payroll cycles. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-12021#update
zach.engineer: I see the 24h back on my balance. Thanks all!
ollie: (ty)
olivia-peopleops: Closing loop  marking ticket resolved. If anyone else sees discrepancies, please reopen the ticket."
